This belongs in Package 2 alongside ספר and שם ה.

additions.reason: The Torah text explicitly identifies the holy books as 'אנפי אורייתא' — the face of Torah — and states that Mashiach's spirit hovers specifically there: 'בְּחִינַת מָשִׁיחַ הוּא שׁוֹרֶה עַל אַנְפֵּי אוֹרַיְתָא, דְּהַיְנוּ הַסְּפָרִים הַקְּדוֹשִׁים שֶׁמְּגַלִּין הַפָּנִים שֶׁל תּוֹרָה'. The phrase 'פָּנִים שֶׁל תּוֹרָה' (face of Torah) is itself a bechina of the ספר — the book is the face through which Torah (water) is revealed. This belongs in Package 2.
additions.source_quote: בְּחִינַת מָשִׁיחַ הוּא שׁוֹרֶה עַל אַנְפֵּי אוֹרַיְתָא, דְּהַיְנוּ הַסְּפָרִים הַקְּדוֹשִׁים שֶׁמְּגַלִּין הַפָּנִים שֶׁל תּוֹרָה

additions.reason: The Torah introduces the concept of 'יחודא תתאה' (lower union — the holy union of man and woman in this world) as a central structural element. The text uses the bechina framing: a union so holy that 'בוֹ תָּלוּי יִחוּדָא עִלָּאָה' — the lower union is the bechina and vessel for the upper union. While not in the dataset, it occupies the same domain as Package 1 (the Mashiach/spirit dimension) — since it is precisely this holy union that the ruach kina'ah of Mashiach guards and whose peace the holy books are sacrificed to protect. It is the positive force that the Mashiach-spirit is oriented toward.
additions.source_quote: יֵשׁ יִחוּדָא תַּתָּאָה שֶׁבְּזֶה הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁהוּא בְּכַשְׁרוּת גָּדוֹל בִּקְדֻשָּׁה וּבְטָהֳרָה כָּל־כָּךְ, עַד שֶׁבּוֹ תָּלוּי יִחוּדָא עִלָּאָה

additions.reason: The Torah explicitly identifies niuf (sexual immorality) as what the Mashiach-nose opposes: 'נִאוּף תָּלוּי בַּחֹטֶם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב לֹא תִנְאָף' — using the bechina of the nose as the seat of both Mashiach and niuf. The ruach kina'ah is specifically aroused by niuf. Niuf is the evil mirror of the Mashiach-package — it is the force that defiles the nose/Mashiach dimension. It belongs in Package 1 as the evil counterpart within that domain.
additions.source_quote: וְנִאוּף תָּלוּי בַּחֹטֶם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: לֹא תִנְאָף, וְאִיתָא בַּמִּדְרָשׁ: לֹא תֵהָנֶה אַף

additions.reason: The Torah explicitly sets up a mirror structure between holy books (ספרים קדושים = שם ה) and heretical books (ספרי מינין). The ספרי מינין are the evil mirror of Package 2 — they spread hatred between Israel where the holy books spread שם ה. The text uses them as the basis for the kal va-chomer: if holy books are erased for peace, all the more so must heretical books be destroyed. They are the evil dimension of the ספר-domain.
